summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of the take-private acquisition of Kennedy-Wilson Holdings, Inc. for $10.90 per share in cash. The transaction, led by a consortium including Kennedy Wilson's CEO William McMorrow and Fairfax affiliates, was completed per the Merger Agreement. Fairfax holds a majority economic interest, while the KW Management Group retains operational control. A $1.3B three-year term loan facility was obtained, with Fairfax providing a stand-by guarantee. Watch for integration execution and the consortium's ability to service the debt given the ownership split.
